description: Research publications (articles, reports, podcasts) with title, provider, date, a short description and the link to the original. Ranked by how well the terms match (title matches count most), then newest; pages via offset / next_offset. Follow the link for the full text where the publisher allows it.

limit.description: Items per page, at most 100. Default 25.

offset.description: Skip this many items; pass the previous response's next_offset to read the next page.

provider_id.description: Limit to one research provider (id from list_providers).

since.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 30 days ago. The free plan reaches back 7 days for individual items.

terms.description: Subject words to match (assets, tickers, countries, central banks, companies, themes). Whole-word, case-insensitive; any term may match. Include synonyms and tickers, e.g. ["gold", "xau", "bullion"]. Omit to get everything in range. Matched against title and description.

until.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Default: today.

name: search_research
title: Search research publications
